title: Can I SURVIVE Bughouse?
summary: Bughouse on chess.com: Tony teams with YouTuber Viper King (2v2 on two boards). Pieces your partner captures go into your hand and can be dropped onto your board. They communicate on voice ('do you need pieces?'). After several games (including abandonments) they get a convincing win with a pawn drop on c2.
rules: Two boards, teams of two; teammates play opposite colours.
Pieces captured by your partner are passed to you and can be dropped on any empty square on your turn (pawns not on 1st/8th rank).
Game ends when either board ends; team result.
win_condition: Your team wins on either board.

board.theme_notes: two chess.com boards side by side with piece banks

current_impl_issues: Impl base:Crazyhouse-lite drops your OWN captures; bughouse needs a simulated partner board feeding pieces (2v2).
